semanticHolds.rationale: A complete text output modality list supports native output scope, but does not alone decide whether image.generation means native image generation or hosted-tool orchestration. Preserve explicit modality evidence without converting to a stronger negative capability assertion.

comparisonPolicy: Use public models.dev observations transformed by the real current adapter. Local DB values remain unverified. Higher-priority source disagreement remains visible; Cloud assertions are fallback/provenance, not automatic corrections.

anthropic-F-opus5-optional.reason: Opus 5 disabled thinking depends on selected effort. An unconditional required=false claim loses that dependency; defer the scalar until conditional projection review.

anthropic-F-opus5-toggle.reason: Opus 5 rejects disabled thinking at xhigh/max. The model-level scalar does not retain this dependency; defer before publication.

anthropic-F-sonnet55-modes.reason: between_tools is restricted to high or lower effort and rejects additional thinking fields. Hold the complete model-level domain until conditional execution semantics are reviewed.

anthropic-F-legacy-temperature-support.reason: Legacy sampling is accepted with thinking off and rejected with thinking on. Preserve the documented conditional fact without emitting an unconditional control assertion.

anthropic-F-legacy-temperature-default.reason: Default applies to legacy Messages sampling when applicable. Thinking-mode dependency needs review before it becomes an unconditional model default.

anthropic-F-legacy-temperature-max.reason: Accepted maximum applies with thinking disabled. Hold conditional model maximum until execution/projection review.

anthropic-F-legacy-topk-support.reason: Legacy top_k acceptance depends on thinking disabled. Hold the unconditional support scalar.

anthropic-F-active-output.reason: Intro documents text output support, but does not explicitly declare an exhaustive canonical output set. Preserve positive text evidence; hold the complete-set proposal.

anthropic-F-context-editing.reason: Context editing requires beta execution headers and action/model conditions; hold for Owner lifecycle review.

anthropic-F-context-actions.reason: Context-management actions require beta headers; first-corpus publication held.

anthropic-F-modern-context-actions.reason: Editing and compaction action union requires their respective beta headers; first-corpus publication held.

anthropic-F-compaction-action.reason: Separate beta compaction surface; no standalone complete provider Rule proposal and no first-corpus lifecycle approval.
